cd /workspace/project && cat > LIGHTVELA_CONFIG.md <<'EOF'
# LightVela — konfigurasi nomask (key baru)

## Key baru (terverifikasi LIVE, $1 masing-masing)

```
20. nmk_live_Tv78qqiEcF3Tb6u2kC5WPRuhWT5MDti94RVaZVQT   (q7016093)
21. nmk_live_FtVn4vczCTzAEeZYSQYF65DSwerrKBsPbuAQJx1l   (q3529860)
22. nmk_live_pZuW9YnhsUNiNy4P14yUcK5ljBLonvvKPyX8LkL6   (q9721691)
```

## Isi form (Management -> Model -> Custom model)

| Field | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Name | `nomask` |
| Base URL | `https://api.nomask.ai/v1` |
| Protocol | **OpenAI Chat Completions** |
| API Key | *(salah satu dari 3 di atas)* |
| Model ID | `deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored` |

## Model yang TERUJI OK di key baru (17 Nov)

| Model | content | reasoning | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored` | ✅ OK | 233 char | reasoning, tapi jawab |
| `glm-5.3_flash_uncensored` | ✅ OK | 126 char | **paling cepat stabil** |
| `qwen_3.8_uncensored` | ✅ OK | 0 | non-reasoning, ringan |
| `gemma-4-uncensored` | ✅ OK | 0 | non-reasoning, ringan |
| `venice-uncensored-1.2` | ✅ OK | 0 | non-reasoning, ringan |
| `mimo-v2.6-flash-uncensored` | ⚠️ 503 | — | "model currently overloaded" |

**Rekomendasi LightVela:** `glm-5.3_flash_uncensored` (cepat) atau
`qwen_3.8_uncensored` (tanpa reasoning, hemat token).

## Kalau muncul error

| Pesan | Sebab | Obat |
|---|---|---|
| `402 insufficient_balance` | saldo habis | ganti ke key 21, lalu 22 |
| `503 model overloaded` | model ramai | ganti model |
| `404 unknown_endpoint` | protocol salah | pilih **OpenAI Chat Completions** |
| `content must be a string` | format tool | LightVela chat = aman; agen = tidak |
| `content` kosong | max_tokens kecil | naikkan |

## Catatan biaya
- Chat pendek: ~$0.00004/request -> $1 bisa ribuan request
- "Check model status" memakan saldo
- Key $1 habis = ganti ke nomor berikutnya di `nomask_live_keys.txt`
EOF
git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Add 3 new verified nomask keys + LightVela config sheet

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
